propositions: OpcertServiceConfig.from_env reads REBAR_OPCERT_PRIVATE_KEY via os.environ.get but does not remove it, leaving the raw PEM accessible to child processes and environment dumps after config load

The inline-PEM path leaves the secret in os.environ for the process lifetime, allowing ssh-keygen and git subprocesses spawned by keyprov and workspace to inherit the raw key despite no explicit env= being passed
The consume-once contract must be enforced: a second from_env() call in the same process should return private_key=None without raising, to prevent silent regressions if a reload path is added later
The pop operation must occur after capturing the value but before any downstream code runs, ensuring compose_signer continues to work while the environment is cleaned
The fix must preserve the literal os.environ.get call signature so that scripts/gen_env_registry.py continues to recognize REBAR_OPCERT_PRIVATE_KEY in docs/env-vars.md
